messages:
anya (PM): Deploybot just flagged APAC canary p95 > 2s and scheduled an auto-rollback. I'm pausing the rollout. Need a quick ops handoff across APAC + UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Canary alert for release rc4_apac — p95 latency 2100ms (threshold 2000ms). Auto-rollback in 5m unless human abort. job=88421.

sam (eng): seeing the same. preliminary logs look like a KV cache spike from synthetic load. can someone delay the auto-rollback while I validate?

leo (sre): we can delay but we should pin the previous version as a safety net. If abort, pin v3.4.2 for APAC.

anya (PM): can someone run the hold command? want to avoid a noisy rollback if it's a false positive.

sam (eng): running: `deployctl hold --region apac --release rc4_apac` — done.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Hold accepted for rc4_apac. Auto-rollback canceled. Monitoring window extended +30m.

leo (sre): pinned old release on the router: `infra pin-version --service inference-api --version v3.4.2 --region apac` — completed. I'll annotate the release notes and ticket.

emily (sales): a few APAC/EU accounts already pinged support about latency. Do we want a proactive one-line note?

anya (PM): yes. short note: "We paused the APAC rollout after an anomalous canary latency spike; investigating. No impact to existing production traffic." Send via support channel.

sam (eng): root cause looks like the synthetic job `canary-smoke-01` misconfigured and hammered 128-token requests, KV cache pressure spiked. prepping a tiny gate in the hotfix branch.

leo (sre): plan: keep pin for 30m while fix merges + CI, then resume traffic at 10% steps. If p95 > 2s for 10 continuous minutes after resume, re-evaluate and open rollback ticket.

anya (PM): I'll draft the customer-facing blurb and update the release notes. Sam, post the PR link here when ready.

sam (eng): PR open: `hotfix/kv-cache-gate` — https://git/repo/pulls/432. want ops signoff before merge.

leo (sre): ops signoff: ✅. I'll monitor dashboards (p95, error-rate, kv-hit-rate). Resume command to run after 30m: `deployctl resume --region apac --gradual 10%`

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Monitoring window active. Alerts watching: p95_latency, error_rate, kv_cache_evictions. If p95 > 2s for 10m, auto-rollback will be re-armed.

emily (sales): drafted note sent to support; included ETA 30m and promise to follow up.

anya (PM): Action items logged: 1) hold release (done) 2) pin v3.4.2 (done) 3) merge hotfix PR after ops signoff 4) monitor 30m 5) resume gradually at ops signal. We'll close this thread when resumed.

sam (eng): ack, merging after a quick CI pass.

leo (sre): ack, I'll watch the alert channels. ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

anya (PM): thanks all — coordinated and calm. will update timeline once resumed.
